items.title: Storm-2603 Hackers Exploit SharePoint ToolShell Flaws to Hide Fileless Backdoor and Launch Ransomware Attack
items.description:
A China-linked threat group tracked as Storm-2603 has used the SharePoint ToolShell flaws to plant a backdoor that never touches the disk. The group then tried to run Warlock ransomware on the same network. The break-in hit an on-premises SharePoint server and ended with a ransomware launch that security software blocked. ToolShell is the name […]
 The post  Storm-2603 Hackers Exploit SharePoint ToolShell Flaws to Hide Fileless Backdoor and Launch Ransomware Attack  appeared first on <a href="https://cybersecuritynews
